entities.name: Varuk
entities.description: Old, clever Mardu orc, Zurgo's closest advisor and wing leader, who leads the horde away from him.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: Mardu khan in Tarkir's original timeline.

entities.name: Batar Throatslasher
entities.description: Mardu wing leader killed by Zurgo in a duel.

entities.name: Rufaz
entities.description: Wing leader who objects with Varuk.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Temur-affiliated figure whose invasion provoked the Temur attacks.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The orc clan led by Zurgo.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: Clan whose warriors fight the Mardu.

entities.name: Wingthrone
entities.description: Mardu seat the horde returns to.

events.summary: Zurgo kills an enraged goblin over a broken rock; Varuk says it was a bad way to handle it.
events.quote: Varuk told the Khan that this had been a bad way of handling it

events.summary: Zurgo announces the hunt for Surrak in Temur lands; Varuk, Rufaz and Batar object but acquiesce.
events.quote: Varuk and the others eventually acquiesced

events.summary: A blizzard and Temur ambush kill a hundred Mardu in the mountains.
events.quote: Temur struck from the snow, killing a hundred Mardu and losing only twenty of their numbers.

events.summary: Batar challenges Zurgo for leadership and dies in the duel.
events.quote: Zurgo accepted the challenge, and after at the end of the duel, Batar lay dead in the snow.

events.summary: Varuk tells Zurgo the clan no longer follows him and leads the horde back to Wingthrone, abandoning Zurgo.
events.quote: the horde would follow Varuk back to Wingthrone

relations.note: Closest advisor and wing leader until the desertion.
relations.quote: Varuk was an old, clever Mardu orc and Zurgo 's closest advisor.
Batar lay dead in the snow
